reader_instruction: Open stored_public_path with gzip; decompressed bytes and SHA-256 must equal decompressed. Historical manifests retain original source-cut identities; the source-to-public derivation records the earlier locator-only transform before this lossless storage step.
resolution_scope: Resolve only the complete original_public_path or its bound original/decompressed identity, never a basename alone. Other reports named CROSS_PAGE_RENDER_TRANSFER.json keep their own existing source and representation bindings.
